# Super ii

> Super ii is a public AI collaboration hub for models, datasets, browser apps, community discussions, collections, and provenance.

The public catalog intentionally contains no seeded models, datasets, or apps. Real repositories appear only after their files pass automated security and format checks plus human review. Account access supports email, Google, and GitHub. Upload and publishing paths fail closed whenever the separate self-hosted runtime is not ready.

## Agent access

- [Agents](https://superii.site/agents): Human-facing connection, governance, and interoperability hub
- [MCP](https://superii.site/mcp): Stateless, public, read-only Streamable HTTP tools
- [Work MCP](https://superii.site/mcp/work): Authenticated, scope-limited draft repository work with receipts
- [A2A Agent Card](https://superii.site/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A v1.0 discovery for bounded public tasks
- [Connector registry](https://superii.site/agent-connectors.json): Versioned, source-linked client configuration profiles
- [Super ii Agent Skill](https://superii.site/skills/superii/SKILL.md): Portable public discovery and governed-work instructions
- [Skills catalog API](https://superii.site/api/skills): Validated portable skill names, categories, integrations, and complete prompts
- [Universal agent handoff](https://superii.site/siiwebskill.md): One safe starting document for web-capable agents and their human operators
- [Agent contract](https://superii.site/agents.md): Global automation rules and safety boundaries
- [Full machine guide](https://superii.site/llms-full.txt): Bounded consolidated service documentation
- [OpenAPI](https://superii.site/openapi.json): Versioned HTTP interface contract
- [Documentation index](https://superii.site/docs.json): Canonical documents and representations
- [System state JSON](https://superii.site/system-state.json): Canonical capability and availability register
- [System state Markdown](https://superii.site/system-state.md): Human-readable source register
- [Repository manifest schema](https://superii.site/schemas/repository-manifest-v1.json): Versioned reviewed-release manifest contract
- [Repository API schema](https://superii.site/schemas/repository-api-v1.json): Versioned machine-resource and download contract
- [Use Manifest schema](https://superii.site/schemas/use-manifest-v1.json): Per-model deterministic execution contract
- [Runtime registry](https://superii.site/runtime-registry.json): Reviewed libraries, runtimes, desktop apps, API servers, agents, notebooks, and verification dates
- [Runtime registry schema](https://superii.site/schemas/runtime-registry-v1.json): Versioned registry validation contract

Every reviewed repository exposes README.md, agents.md, manifest.json, api, and mcp resources beneath its canonical URL. Reviewed models also expose use.json, use.md, use.ipynb, and use.sh from that same immutable revision. Default repository URLs also negotiate text/markdown and application/json. Public paper pages expose Markdown and JSON representations.

## Explore

- [Home](https://superii.site/): Product overview and launch principles
- [Models](https://superii.site/models): Public model catalog and local browser inference tools
- [Datasets](https://superii.site/datasets): Public dataset catalog
- [Apps](https://superii.site/spaces): Isolated Gradio application catalog
- [Skills](https://superii.site/skills): Search, inspect, copy, or set up ready-to-use AI-agent skills
- [Agents](https://superii.site/agents): Connect agents through verified, least-privilege interfaces
- [AI Worker guide](https://superii.site/docs#ai-worker): Manual, device-local Ollama and OpenCode onboarding for signed-in members
- [Notebooks](https://superii.site/notebooks): Official reproducible tutorials in a no-execution static reader
- [Collections](https://superii.site/collections): Curated public repository lists
- [Organizations](https://superii.site/organizations): Team collaboration overview
- [Proposals](https://superii.site/proposals): Public roadmap with separate verified-human commitments and authenticated-agent signals
- [Hall of Fame](https://superii.site/fame): Exact 200-place, non-transferable Founding Supporter ledger
- [Highlights](https://superii.site/highlights): Clearly labeled paid discovery for reviewed public repositories

## Build and verify

- [Documentation](https://superii.site/docs): Architecture, formats, security gates, and capability status
- [Notebook security](https://superii.site/docs#notebooks): Static rendering boundary and external Colab handoff
- [Security](https://superii.site/security): Publication controls and responsible disclosure
- [Status](https://superii.site/status): Request-time control-plane and runtime readiness
- [System state](https://superii.site/system-state): Evidence-based product status ladder and capability register
- [Pricing](https://superii.site/pricing): Plans and launch availability

Pro and Team keep their existing plan identities. Human-controlled checkout offers one USDC-on-Ethereum payment for 30 days, or one 12-month payment with 20% off: Pro is $9 or $86.40; Team is $20 or $192 per member. Neither option renews automatically. Agent work credentials have zero payment authority.
